acceptance.description: Implement exact loopback browser admission and strict JSON schemas for listed pairing/read routes; reject a BOM-prefixed otherwise-valid pair JSON body without consuming its code; deny invalid origins/hosts/credentials, unknown methods/routes, WebSocket and all domain mutations before effects.
Implement one-use bounded in-memory pairing and read-only per-tab capability lifecycle with independent expiry, heartbeat and revoke.

Provide accessible manual pairing, fixture reads and revoke using direct credential-omitting requests and memory-only capability state; validate the complete snapshot response before composing its separately validated events array.

Verify actual Chromium development-origin preflight/pair/read/revoke, opaque denied-Origin behavior, server-enforced capability expiry and per-tab isolation; HTTP tests cover rejected metadata, restart invalidation, WebSocket closure, strict JSON grammar and originless same-origin read. Assert unknown/mutation paths do not change synthetic state; static code review verifies no SDK, filesystem or process-execution call sites. This is partial evidence only and does not complete parent BB-01..10 scenarios or runtime handler/effect counters; no OS-isolation guarantee is claimed.
Pass current focused and workspace checks, independent code review, and running-application design QA without unresolved high/critical findings.

bridge-security-unit.scope: Synthetic in-process loopback bridge tests for route admission, strict pairing/control JSON grammar, pairing and capability state; no external network or SDK.

workbench-web-test.scope: Frontend unit tests for direct bridge client and synthetic UI state, including malformed snapshot events with valid separate events; no services or user data.

bridge-browser-e2e.scope: Chromium against owned synthetic loopback UI and bridge on 127.0.0.1:5420 and :5318; direct CORS pairing/read/revoke, actual denied-Origin opacity, server-enforced capability expiry and per-tab isolation; Playwright tracing/HAR disabled; no user data, SDK or external service.

workspace-lint.scope: Uncached local static analysis; no services or external network.

workspace-typecheck.scope: Uncached local typechecking; no services or external network.

workspace-format-check.scope: Uncached read-only formatting verification; no services or external network.

local-bridge-build.scope: Local TypeScript output under the bridge project dist; no SDK host, services, user data or external network.

workbench-web-build.scope: Local Vite build output under the web project dist; no publication, telemetry, services or external network.
